# Isaiah Chapter 42 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 155r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_042_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**42:1** "Behold my-servant [avdi] whom-I-uphold [etmokh-bo], my-chosen [bechiri] [in whom] my-soul [nafshi] delights [ratsetah]; I-have-put [natati] my-spirit [ruchi] upon-him; justice [mishpat] to-the-nations [la-goyim] he-will-bring-forth [yotsi]."

**42:2** "He-will-not cry-out [lo yits'aq] and-will-not lift [velo yissa], and-will-not cause-to-be-heard [velo yashmia] in-the-street [ba-chuts] his-voice [qolo]."

**42:3** "A-bruised [ratuts] reed [qaneh] he-will-not break [lo yishbor], and-a-dim [kehah] wick [pishtah] he-will-not extinguish [lo yekhabbennah]; to-truth [le-emet] he-will-bring-forth justice."

**42:6** "I, YHWH, have-called-you [qerathikha] in-righteousness [ve-tsedeq], and-I-will-hold [ve'achzeq] your-hand [be-yadkha], and-I-will-keep-you [ve'ettsorkha], and-I-will-give-you [ve'ettenekha] as-a-covenant [li-verit] of-the-people [am], a-light [le-or] of-the-nations [goyim]."

**42:7** "To-open [lifqoach] blind [ivrot] eyes [einayim], to-bring-out [lehotsi] from-prison [mi-masger] the-prisoner [assir], from-the-dungeon [mi-beit keleh] those-who-sit [yoshevei] in-darkness [choshekh]."

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 42 — "The Servant of the LORD" — part of Second Isaiah (chs.40-55). The Babylonian exile and coming restoration shape the theological vision.

---
## Disagreement Log

Minor register disagreements resolved through standard SOPHIA consensus process.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
